# Question 4
```{r}
two_sd=2*sd(flights$arr_delay, na.rm = TRUE)
data<- flights %>%
    mutate(arr_delay_category=case_when(
      arr_delay>=-5 & arr_delay<=5 ~ "On-time",
      arr_delay>=-two_sd & arr_delay<=two_sd ~ "Common delays",
      TRUE ~ "Long delay"
    )) %>%
    select(year, month, day, arr_delay, arr_delay_category)

subset(data, arr_delay_category=="On-time")
subset(data, arr_delay_category=="Common delays")
subset(data, arr_delay_category=="Long delay")
```

# Question 5

#### ***The delays in the descending order of the "mean_arr_delay"***
```{r}
flights %>%
  group_by(dest) %>%
  summarise(mean_arr_delay=mean(arr_delay, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_dep_delay=mean(dep_delay, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups='drop') %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_arr_delay))
```

#### ***The delays in the descending order of the "mean_dep_delay" ***
```{r}
flights %>%
  group_by(dest) %>%
  summarise(mean_arr_delay=mean(arr_delay, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_dep_delay=mean(dep_delay, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups='drop') %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_dep_delay))
```

# Question 6

```{r}
df1<-flights %>%
  group_by(dest) %>%
  summarise(mean_arr_delay=mean(arr_delay, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_dep_delay=mean(dep_delay, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(dest %in% c("PDX", "DCA", "LNK", "JAC", "SAT", "ORD", "MIA"))

df2<-airports %>%
  filter(faa %in% c("PDX", "DCA", "LNK", "JAC", "SAT", "ORD", "MIA")) %>%
  select(dest="faa","name","lat","lon")

df <- left_join(df1, df2, by="dest")
df
```

# Question 7

```{r}
usa <- map_data('usa')

ggplot(data=usa, aes(x=long, y=lat, group=group), stat = "identity") + 
  geom_polygon(fill='lightblue') + 
  theme(axis.title.x=element_blank(), axis.text.x=element_blank(), axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
        axis.title.y=element_blank(), axis.text.y=element_blank(), axis.ticks.y=element_blank()) + 
  geom_point(data = df,
             aes(x = lon, y = lat, group=dest),
             color = "black", alpha=0.8) +
  geom_text(data=df, aes(x=lon, y=lat, group=dest, label=paste("Arr_Del :",round(mean_arr_delay,2),"\n","Dep_del :",round(mean_dep_delay,2))), vjust=-0.25, size=3)+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```


# Question 8

```{r}
df3 <- flights %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarise(mean_arr_delay=mean(arr_delay, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_dep_delay=mean(dep_delay, na.rm = TRUE),
            ) %>%
  mutate(cumulative_arr_delays=cumsum(mean_arr_delay),
         cumulative_dep_delays=cumsum(mean_dep_delay))

df3
```

# Question 9

```{r}
df4 <- df3 %>% select("month",delays="cumulative_arr_delays")
df4["delay_type"]="cumulative_arr_delays"

df5 <- df3 %>% select("month",delays="cumulative_dep_delays")
df5["delay_type"]="cumulative_dep_delays"

df6 <- rbind(df4, df5) %>%
  relocate("month","delay_type","delays")%>%
  arrange(month)

df6

```

# Question 10
```{r}
ggplot(data=df6, aes(x=month, y=delays))+
  geom_point()+
  facet_wrap(~ delay_type)
```
